senses.gloss:
प The twenty-first consonant of the Deva Nāgri alphabet, corres-
ponding to the letter P.

प m. (-पः)
 1. Air, wind 2. A prince, a ruler.
 3. A leaf.
 4. An egg.
 f.
(-पा) (at the end of compounds).
 1. Drinking, (as in अनेकप)
 2.
Guarding, Protecting, ruling. (As in गोप)
 E. पा to nourish, &c.
aff. ड ।

प(पि)ञ्जर mn. (-रः-रं) A skeleton.
 n. (-रं)
 1. A cage, an aviary, a dove-cot.
2. The ribs.
 m. (-रः)
 1. The body.
 2. The Kali age.
 E. पजि for
पिजि to dwell, &c. Unādi aff. अरच्; also पिञ्जर.

पा r. 1st. cl. (पिवति) To drink. r. 2nd. cl. (पाति) To cherish, to
nourish, to protect or preserve. पाने, भ्वा-पर-सक-अनिट् । रक्षणे,
अदा-पर-सक-सेट् ।

पा mfn. (पाः-पाः-पं)
 1. Who drinks.
 2. Who protects or cherishes.
 3.
To feast on, (with the eyes or ears.)
 4. To absorb, to swallow up,
to destroy.
 E. पा to drink, &c. क्विप् aff.
